data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter extension library for strings, collections, dates, numbers, and colors.
data.what_it_does: Provides practical extensions and helper methods for standard Dart and Flutter types like String, List, Map, num, DateTime, Duration, and Color. It includes safe-access methods, common formatting, parsing utilities, and Kotlin-style scope functions.
use_when: You want a single utility library for common string manipulation, list operations, and date arithmetic.
You want Kotlin-style scope functions like let, also, and takeIf in Dart.
avoid_when: You prefer to keep your dependency tree minimal and only write your own tiny extension helpers.
You are concerned about namespace pollution from adding a broad set of type extensions.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage across many standard data types and Flutter classes.
Includes helpful built-in regex patterns and safe-access methods for collections.
weaknesses: Adds general extensions to core Dart types which can occasionally conflict with other utility packages.
